captions.source: Letter of 29 Oct 2026 from Rep. Greg Casar and 19 other House Democrats to Sam Altman; 11 questions (FourWeekMBA, 'Ask OpenAI 11 Questions'; plan 49). Search summaries, 19 and 21 Nov; the letter itself could not be opened from the build machine.

Tomek Korbak, Mikita Balesni and Jasmine Wang, named in the letter (reports). OpenAI spokesperson: 'These personnel decisions were not about raising safety concerns or speaking out' (as quoted by Common Dreams/FourWeekMBA summaries; CNBC 9 Oct renders it without 'personnel'). The researchers say they never shared confidential data (The Deep Dive). Both sides on screen as tags.
Letter of 29 Oct: answers requested by Friday 13 Nov 2026 (FourWeekMBA; TNW; plan 49).
Searches on 19, 20 and 21 Nov 2026 found no public response from OpenAI to the 29 Oct letter. Said as 'found so far', never 'ignored'.
The station's line: the letter was sent and published; nothing has come back in public.
